capability.summary: Cost-oriented reasoning tier for high-volume workloads.
capability.problem_space: Language model for bounded, high-volume text and visual tasks. Applicable tasks include classification, information extraction, summarization, instruction following. Accepts text, image input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions. Published distinction: The provider positions this in the tier corresponding to earlier nano variants. Native reasoning extends through max with a 1,050,000-token context; neither model age nor tier establishes a supplier performance ranking.

constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
